subtitle: Lesson 99 · Database Design Fundamentals

caption: Removes the table's structure and every row of data. No undo short of a backup.
Quietly does nothing if the table isn't there — common at the top of setup scripts.
SQL Server refuses the drop while another object still depends on the table.

code:
TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.LessonDemo;  -- empties it, table still exists
DROP TABLE dbo.LessonDemo;      -- the table itself is gone
caption: TRUNCATE keeps the structure standing. DROP removes the table entirely.

subtitle: Auto-incrementing keys, and the safe way to read the value back.
